cleavage_agent.evidence: Total protein from each sample was reduced, alkylated, and digested using single-pot, solid-phase-enhanced sample preparation [Nature Protocols 14: 68-85 (2018)] with sequencing grade modified porcine trypsin (Promega).

instrument.evidence: Eluted peptides were ionized by electrospray (2.4 kV) through a heated capillary (275°C) followed by data collection on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
